meta.name: identify-assumptions-new
meta.description: Identify risky assumptions for a new product idea across 8 risk categories including Go-to-Market, Strategy, and Team. Use when evaluating startup risks, assessing a new product concept, or mapping assumptions for a new venture.

copy.tagline: 识别新产品创意的关键假设与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在评估一个新产品的可行性或寻找潜在风险点。
copy.tagline_en: Identify key assumptions and risks for a new product idea
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are evaluating a new product's feasibility or uncovering hidden risks.

howto.what: 分析新产品创意，从8个风险类别（价值、可用性、可行性、生存力、伦理、市场进入、战略与目标、团队）识别有风险的假设，并给出信心评级和测试建议。
howto.when: 当你描述一个新产品概念、目标用户和功能想法时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个新产品创意的假设风险：一款面向小企业的AI记账工具。
say.note: 技能会从8个类别识别风险假设。

say.text: 评估我的新产品概念：一个远程团队协作平台，目标用户是设计师。
say.note: 技能会从产品经理、设计师、工程师三个视角分析。

howto.what_en: Analyzes a new product idea, identifies risky assumptions across 8 categories (Value, Usability, Feasibility, Viability, Ethics, Go-to-Market, Strategy & Objectives, Team), and suggests confidence ratings and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a new product concept, target segment, and feature idea.

say_en.text: Help me analyze assumptions for a new product idea: an AI bookkeeping tool for small businesses.
say_en.note: The skill identifies risky assumptions across 8 categories.

say_en.text: Evaluate my new product concept: a remote team collaboration platform for designers.
say_en.note: The skill analyzes from PM, designer, and engineer perspectives.
